OBS-09: records identical rental/date bookings accepted twice
OBS-10: records the absence of a cleaning fee or total in the saved view
OBS-11: reproduces the empty rental list on a fresh direct booking route
OBS-12: records unchanged content after the More and Save buttons
OBS-13: records that bookings disappear after the app is remounted
